Publication at the international IEEE VisWeek Conference 2010


The paper "Understanding Complex Multithreaded Software Systems by Using Trace Visualization" has been presented by Jonas Trümper at the ACM Symposium on Software Visualization in Salt Lake City (USA), which is part of the IEEE VisWeek Conference. The paper is coauthored by Johannes Bohnet and Jürgen Döllner.  At the same symposium, Martin Beck presented his extended abstract "Towards Automated Analysis and Visualization of Distributed Software Systems".
